description: Source code for VoiceWakeRuntime actor managing voice wake recognition, audio input, and recognition pipeline for a macOS app, including recognition session management, audio level monitoring, and interaction with UI overlays.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: An actor managing the voice wake recognition process, including audio input handling, recognition session lifecycle, and interaction with overlays and application state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates runtime state based on application state, starts or stops recognition accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition pipeline with given configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition pipeline and related resources.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the speech recognizer with the specified locale.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition updates, manages trigger detection, and initiates capture.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs recognition transcripts and segments for debugging.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs RMS audio levels from input buffers.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs recognition callback results.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a task to check if trigger-only detection should be paused.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check for silence to fallback to recognition.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Checks if trigger-only detection conditions are still valid and triggers capture.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Checks for silence or fallback recognition detection.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Starts voice capture and recognition after trigger detection.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors ongoing capture session for silence or timeout to end capture.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Ends capture, processes transcript, updates overlays, and schedules recognizer restart.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Adjusts noise floor estimate and updates UI with input level.

methods.name: rmsLevel
methods.description: Calculates RMS level of audio buffer.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts the speech recognizer to listen for the next trigger.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Restarts recognizer if not capturing and overlay is hidden.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a delayed restart of the recognizer.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Sets cooldown until next recognition trigger, typically after push-to-talk.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Pauses recognition to wait for push-to-talk activation.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Marks that audio has been heard beyond trigger detection.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts command text following trigger words.

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts command following trigger and optionally up to trigger end time.
